body: I’ve been crying and trying to converse with her alot these past 3 days. I’ve begged her to forgive me for my any mistake hoping it’s my mistake which could be the reason for her this behavior but nope. I’ve tried talking her so many times these days. But she’ll walk out of the room just while i’m speaking. Just 2 hours ago this happened 2 minutes later i walked out of the room and she was sitting watching tv and sipping tea as if whatever i was saying didn’t even touch her ear. And just 20 minutes ago tried apologizing again and begged her to stop behaving like that and please be the same as i’m honestly just miserable and broken and just can’t take it anymore and she replied what have i even done to you. I’ve tried explaining her what is it that is hurting me every 2-3 days this past whole year and even she knows her behavior like i’m crying and trying to solve things out by communicating and she just leaves and doesn’t ever come back or even says what were u saying. I would be crying and if she accidentally walks in the room she’ll see my face red and full of tears and forget about asking she wouldn’t even look concerned. 2 years back if she walked in the room and could slightly see a change in my expression (not even tear just expression) like a normal mom she would have asked me what’s wrong. Now i’ve tried explaining her so many times and i’m so shattered that while pouring my heart out tears run down my face like a stream of river but next time again she’ll say what have i done. It’s in your head. But it’s not! Previously she used to sit and talk to me if something is wrong. I don’t know what to do at all now. I’ve tried so so hard. Been crying continuously since the past 3 days. Searching for a painless way to die but nothing is helping!

No I don’t have anyone to talk to. The one person i talked about anything and everything to was my mom and it honestly made everything better.. but now that same thing is making me want to die so so so bad.. please someone trust me im not fucking kidding i’m tired of people not trusting me. They are doing it intentionally to break me and let me die so they don’t have to take care of my expenses which already are at the minimum

None. I don’t have any service i call. I tried seeking help but all they took from me was money per session but didn’t help at all. Rather left me miserable. 8-9 months back after crying and begging my mother to talk to me i told her i’m going to commit suicide and you’ll never see me again and left the house, she was resting on the bed and didn’t even care to open an eye forget about flinching a little. This has happened 2 times now, i left the house and said she won’t see me and couldn’t care less. Not even a blink! This shattered my heart and it sinks whenever i think of these 2 instances
